values.summary: Bootstrap #494 after #493 terminal ancestry, approve a design centered on a disposable On-Demand L4 smoke test, bind a FastWork worktree, implement Terraform/runbook/evidence/validation surfaces, execute the paid proof only within the USD 20 cap, obtain exact-head review, publish with closing linkage, and finish when green.

steps.action: Bootstrap and approve the GCP-E L4 smoke-test design from current main containing #493 terminal truth.
Bind the #494 FastWork execution worktree and preserve dependency/collision truth.
Implement disposable GPU-smoke Terraform, runbook, evidence packet, cleanup proof, and issue-owned validator.
Execute the authorized paid L4 smoke within USD 20, validate cleanup, obtain fresh exact-head review, publish with closing linkage, and finish when green.

invariants: The workload is disposable and issue-labeled for deterministic cleanup
No checked-in credential, key material, token, or raw account secret appears in source or evidence
The proof records the exact project, zone, machine type, image, GPU type/count, driver/CUDA surface, Ollama/model input, deadline, and observed cost envelope
The paid run stops under the USD 20 ceiling and destroys/quarantines no unique evidence
Independent zero-resource checks prove no #494-owned compute, disk, IP, firewall, service-account, or storage residue remains
DRT-D, XCL-01, AWS-G, production traffic, Unity, and Observatory scope remain non-goals
risks: Quota or regional capacity may not allow the chosen L4 shape
A GPU image may boot but fail driver/CUDA/Ollama readiness
Cleanup selectors could miss residual disks, addresses, or service accounts
A live proof could leak credentials or overly detailed account material if evidence is not redacted
Costs can rise if deadline enforcement or destroy steps fail
stop_conditions: Paid execution would exceed the USD 20 ceiling
Quota or capacity cannot satisfy the exact On-Demand L4 shape
The selected image cannot prove GPU/driver/CUDA/Ollama readiness within the bounded run
Cleanup or independent zero-resource verification fails
A proposed proof would read, print, copy, retain, or commit credential material
A proposed change would implement six-resident qualification, XCL-01 parity, AWS-G retirement, production deployment, Observatory, Unity, or provider-profile work
